items.t: Worn valve seats cause misfires and lost compression
items.job: Replace or recondition cylinder head
items.note: Owners report shop quotes of $4,000-6,000. A machine-shop valve job on the original head costs less; a replacement engine costs more.

items.t: 4-speed automatic slips or loses gears
items.job: Rebuild or replace 4L60-E automatic transmission

items.t: Blower fan works only on some speeds or not at all
items.job: Replace blower motor resistor and wiring connector
items.note: If the blower motor itself is worn, add roughly $80-200 for the motor.

items.t: Passlock security light and engine won't crank
items.job: Replace ignition switch or Passlock sensor
items.note: Each part is about $100; one owner was quoted $800-1,200 at a shop.

items.t: Timing chain rattle at startup
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner
items.note: An owner was quoted about $3,800. If the chain jumped and damaged the valves, the cost can roughly double.

items.t: Cam phaser (VVT actuator) rattle and rough running
items.job: Replace cam phaser oil control solenoid or actuator
items.note: The solenoid alone is about $60 and quick to change; the actuator needs more labor.

items.t: EVAP leak or gas cap check engine light
items.job: Replace gas cap, EVAP vent valve or canister
items.note: A new cap is the cheapest fix; an EVAP canister is about $200.

items.t: Frame and body rust
items.job: Rust repair on body panels or frame sections
items.note: Small body repairs run a few hundred dollars; frame repairs can cost thousands.

items.t: Brake lights may fail or stay on (recall)
items.job: Replace brake lamp switch (recall)

items.t: Hood may be missing its secondary latch (recall)
items.job: Replace hood with secondary latch (recall)

items.t: Rear axle pin can break and lock the rear wheels (recall)
items.job: Replace rear differential cross pin (recall)

items.t: Power steering assist cuts out suddenly (recall)
items.job: Replace steering gear torque sensor cover (recall)

items.t: Driver front air bag may not inflate correctly (recall)
items.job: Inspect, reprogram or replace driver air bag (recall)

items.t: 8-speed automatic shudders at light throttle
items.job: Full transmission fluid exchange with updated GM fluid
items.note: If the shudder comes back, a torque converter replacement can push the bill into the thousands.

items.t: Diesel particulate filter and DEF warnings
items.job: Replace exhaust or DEF sensor, or particulate filter
items.note: A sensor is about $200; a new particulate filter is around $2,000.

items.t: Diesel warning lights and no-start from rubbed-through wiring
items.job: Inspect and repair chafed diesel engine harness

items.t: DEF warning on freezing cold starts (emissions recall)
items.job: Reprogram engine control module (emissions recall)

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump can come loose and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump and line (recall)

items.t: Front brake calipers may leak fluid (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front calipers (recall)

items.t: Turbo engine wiring harness rubs through
items.job: Inspect and repair engine harness near the turbo
items.note: Usually covered by the new-vehicle warranty.

items.t: Coolant leak at the radiator hose quick-connect
items.job: Replace radiator hose quick-connect seal and refill coolant
items.note: Free under GM special coverage N262546590 for 5 years or 60,000 miles.

items.t: Automatic emergency braking slams on for no reason (recall)
items.job: Update front camera module software (recall)

items.t: Front wheel hub bolts may be damaged (recall)
items.job: Replace front wheel hub bolts (recall)

items.t: Front seat belt buckle bolt may be loose (recall)
items.job: Tighten front seat belt buckle bolt (recall)

items.t: Fuel pump lock ring may not be locked (recall)
items.job: Inspect and lock fuel pump ring (recall)

items.t: Headlights may flicker (recall)
items.job: Replace headlight control module (recall)

items.t: AT4X AEV passenger air bag may fire too hard (recall)
items.job: Update air bag module software (recall)
